summary:
research/SYNTHESIS.md (~1,840 words, bullets and tables only, no abstract prose).
Thesis MODIFIED: 'undo is a dependency problem' is confirmed (RES-02/04/06). Killed: 'nobody has provenance containment' (Airlock) and 'nobody has agent undo' (Wang 2608.10502, State Footprints). 'No multi-agent incident' is overturned: OpenAI/HF is real (METR ~1,200 agents / ~700 attackers), but there is still no public case of B consuming A's bad write and being repaired.
Recommended frame: PROVENANCE-FIRST (Panel 5.2), with backward recovery as the demo payoff and 'testimony vs evidence' as why it matters. Niche vs Airlock: the backward half, an authenticated record, and recovery scored as (R, C).
Also in the file: 15-row fact sheet with wording rules, URLs and verification status (5 rows re-verified by me today); consolidated do-not-claim list; 10 principles mapped to components; Panel must-fix list mapped to ADR owners (vikram/nisha/arjun/tara); positioning vs 8 systems; merged metric set (TTI-detect/attribute, Panel TTC + post-alert tainted effects, oracle-defined B/G, R/C, re-plan cost); 13 Call #1 decisions with recommended answers.
Corrections: DeltaBox has no v3 (RES-06 wrong). Atomix authors confirmed.
review: [panel · done] Synthesis accepted as the Call #1 working document: clear thesis status, verified fact sheet with wording rules, do-not-claim list, principles traced to evidence, oracle-based metrics.
